descriptionChirho: To acquire material wealth or become financially prosperous, used of merchants, the covetous, or the self-deceived (Lk 1:53; 12:21; Rev 3:17; 18:3,15,19).
To be enriched by God in spiritual blessings, grace, or salvific bounty (Rom 10:12; 1 Cor 4:8; 2 Cor 8:9; 1 Tim 6:9,18; Rev 3:18).
